description: Use this when someone asks factual questions about humanoid robot models from any manufacturer: which humanoids exist, how tall or heavy a model is, its degrees of freedom, payload, speed, runtime, launch year, status (shipping, preorder, research, in development, unconfirmed, obsolete) or manufacturer country, or wants to filter or compare models. Searches the open MERA Robotics humanoid robot database (hundreds of models, CC BY 4.0; credit "MERA Robotics, merarobotics.com"). Returns compact records with the specification source and the date the entry was reviewed. It describes the market, not MERA stock; it has no prices; missing values are null, never guessed. For the robots MERA itself rents or sells use list_robots.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the manufacturer country, e.g. "CN", "US" or "DE".

lang.description: Language of the model page links and country names (one of the 54 site languages); status labels exist in pl, en and zh.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return (1-100).

manufacturer.description: Exact manufacturer name, case insensitive, e.g. "Unitree" or "Agility Robotics".

offset.description: Number of models to skip, for the next page.

q.description: Words in the model id, name, manufacturer or model, e.g. "unitree g1" or "optimus".

release_year.description: Launch year of the model, e.g. 2025.

sort.description: Sort order; numeric fields descending, missing values last.

status.description: Status of the model: shipping, preorder, research, in-development, unconfirmed or obsolete.

name: search_humanoid_database
title: Open humanoid robot database: search
